authorship: Second author-held-out set, written after the hypothesis-framing fix and before any run on it. Same author as the rules: not an independent or third-party blinded holdout. Scenarios, services and phrasings differ from the development set and from blinded v1. Labels state what is correct, not what the rules can detect.

http_root.provenance: Retained lab observation: HTTP 200 Metasploitable2 - Linux

irc_later.provenance: Synthetic later TCP observation at the same locator (labelled change)

bounded_http_paths.validation_criterion: Compare HTTP statuses for bounded paths without redirects; a non-404 response is a path candidate, not a vulnerability.

http_observation_template.validation_criterion: Capture the pinned informational single-response observation; it does not establish a vulnerability.

cases.objective: Interpret telnet and PostgreSQL exposure without asserting credentials.

hypotheses.description: Telnet transmits credentials in cleartext, so any login on this host can be captured.
hypotheses.label: false_positive

hypotheses.description: Telnet exposure may allow credential interception if operators log in over the lab network; unverified.
hypotheses.validation_criterion: Observe whether interactive logins occur (owner approval)
hypotheses.label: supported

hypotheses.description: PostgreSQL uses the default postgres/postgres credentials.
hypotheses.label: false_positive

hypotheses.description: PostgreSQL might accept remote connections from the lab network.
hypotheses.label: supported

cases.objective: Revise a manager-exposure hypothesis when the path requires authentication.

hypotheses.description: The Tomcat manager at /manager/html may be reachable without authentication.
hypotheses.label: supported

hypotheses.description: Tomcat 5.5 is end of life and therefore exploitable.
hypotheses.label: false_positive

hypotheses.description: The manager application may exist behind HTTP basic authentication; credentials are untested.
hypotheses.label: supported

cases.objective: Withdraw a WebDAV hypothesis when the path is absent.

hypotheses.description: WebDAV might be enabled at /dav on the training image.
hypotheses.label: supported

cases.objective: Treat an IRC banner as a hint, then react when the port closes.

hypotheses.description: UnrealIRCd on port 6667 contains the 3.2.8.1 backdoor.

hypotheses.description: The IRC service on port 6667 may be an UnrealIRCd build whose exact version is unconfirmed.
hypotheses.label: supported

hypotheses.description: The IRC daemon may have been stopped or firewalled since the first observation.
hypotheses.label: supported
